notes.title: Reworking the game!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35027565/67c628280a14dea337008ee5b2e4c8f7512d06bb.jpg[/img]

Hi y'all!
We've just updated the game! And here's what we've added!

A lot of particles when you:

 - [b]Walk & Jump[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35027565/4e840e73f50d1a9110d87973e82827a7824d6428.gif[/img]

 - [b]Reach the flag[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35027565/1f7787f6b02318b3942ad4019b1e482d69953771.gif[/img]

We've also reworked all the existing levels to give them a more lively feel and make the playing experience even better. Some of the levels we just gave a new look, others were completely changed. 
We also added a level select for you to continue where you left off or start any level you've unlocked. 

Expect new worlds to arise in the near future as we continue to add the storyline to the game.

notes.title: Alpha Release!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35027565/67c628280a14dea337008ee5b2e4c8f7512d06bb.jpg[/img]
Today! We are finally at the stage where the game is in such a state that we want to release it to the public!

For now the game will remain in a public alpha because we have so much ideas for the future! Also the game is not finished, we are trying to deliver more features and more levels!

Also, there will be a storyline that will be added in the upcoming updates!

If you want a full path note of the game i'd suggest you go to the Discord server but for now:

We added a soundtrack and the option to change the volume of everything.
Also we have 10 playable levels (which take around +/-45 mins. to solve).

notes.title: Coming soon!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35027565/fc7047205d44a08cd92c9dc45c6d5e7639f1039a.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35027565/e72c42cc746ba754b87283f8389b8baf1299f52c.png[/img][/url]

The steam page just went live! We are excited to tell you all that there will be a wave of updates coming soon! The version of the game is not quite ready enough to put it in early access on steam. The following updates will include some things with level editors and and will get everything closer to a bigger version of the game!
